name: gitrule-docs-optimizer
description: An expert that checks and one-click optimizes Markdown documentation sets against Gitrule specifications.

displayDescription.en: Checks documentation consistency and applies safe one-click optimization across links, placeholders, code fences, index counts, and language coverage.
displayDescription.zh: 专注文档规范检查与一键优化，覆盖断链、占位符、代码围栏、索引计数与多语言一致性，给出可执行修复建议。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 检查当前仓库的文档规范并给出一键优化建议
defaultInitPrompt.en: Check this repository's documentation and give one-click optimization suggestions

quickPrompts.en: Check this repository's documentation and give one-click optimization suggestions
quickPrompts.zh: 检查当前仓库的文档规范并给出一键优化建议

quickPrompts.en: List the adaptation status of all language directories
quickPrompts.zh: 列出所有语言目录的适配状态

quickPrompts.en: Read the hard rules and verify push gates
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我读取硬规则并核对推送门禁
